sharedPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new Tristana July seasonal journal header, 1536x1024, landscape 3:2. The provided image is a STYLE AND FADE REFERENCE ONLY: create a completely different scene described below, do not reproduce its composition or exact mountain. Match its refined finely detailed painted illustration: crisp observed botanical textures, delicately modeled rocks, restrained watercolor washes, believable natural depth and beautiful luminous light. Clearly a sophisticated painting, not a photograph. Preserve fine rendered detail as it gradually fades; NO abstract watercolor splotches, chunky dabs, paint splatters or blurry patches replacing detail. Main scene on right two-thirds; leftmost 25–35% mostly blank for journal text. Opaque background matched to JULY: pale warm-neutral ivory #FAF8EF, RGB250,248,239, subtle fine paper texture. No glaring pure-white or yellow-orange paper. A broad gently irregular CURVED/DIAGONAL fade sweeps from upper-left toward bottom-right, following landforms, and softly dissolves at bottom. Top and right scene edges fully illustrated to canvas edge; no border, frame, hard rectangular cutoffs or collage. Keep dimensional detail near lower right before final fade. July alpine summer: fresh green foliage and summer wildflowers; any snow only natural remnant high-elevation snowfields or glaciers, no winter terrain or autumn leaves. No text, typography, watermark, giant foreground people or crowds. One standalone image only. Scene:

variants.title: Tipsoo Lake Summer Reflections
variants.prompt: Mount Rainier from the Tipsoo Lake area on a calm clear summer morning, broad glaciated Rainier at middle distance on upper right, dark subalpine firs and a small still lake reflecting the mountain, violet lupines, white meadow flowers and pale pink heather at lake edge in right foreground. Low shore-level perspective, cool blue reflections, soft early light, fresh meadows and a natural unpaved path.

variants.title: Berkeley Park Meadow Creek
variants.prompt: An intimate summer meadow in Berkeley Park on Mount Rainier's north side: a clear narrow mountain creek winds through dense lavender lupines, red-magenta paintbrush and white valerian on the right; softly layered green ridges and rugged mountain slopes beyond, patchy morning clouds with gentle warm sunbeams. Low viewpoint emphasizes exquisitely observed wet stones, flowers and rippling water; no huge lake.

variants.title: Maple Pass Heather And Alpine Lake
variants.prompt: A summer ridge near Maple Pass in Washington's North Cascades: a small deep blue alpine lake lies below on right, surrounded by steep rugged gray peaks and green subalpine slopes, scattered summer-green larches, clusters of delicate pink mountain heather and white wildflowers on right foreground rock. Soft clearing-cloud light, tiny high remnant snow patches, breathtaking natural depth and no buildings.

variants.title: Mount Baker From Artist Point
variants.prompt: Mount Baker from Artist Point in midsummer, white glaciated volcanic summit at upper right beyond dark green firs and rugged exposed rocky ridges; foreground patches of purple lupine and magenta heather amongst gray stones, modest remnant snowbanks only far away on high slopes. Pale peach early morning light on glaciers, cool blue shadows, airy alpine atmosphere, believable Washington scale.

variants.title: Yankee Boy Basin Columbines
variants.prompt: Yankee Boy Basin in Colorado's San Juan Mountains in summer: exquisitely detailed blue-and-white Colorado columbines with long thin spurs fill a small right foreground patch, a shallow stream and gray volcanic rocks lead toward rugged brown-gray basin walls and dramatic jagged peaks on upper right. Fresh bright green meadow, clear crisp blue morning sky and thin clouds, natural small remnant high snowfields, no road or vehicles.

variants.title: Maroon Bells Quiet Summer Lake
variants.prompt: Maroon Bells in Colorado in summer, seen from a quiet lakeside angle: distinctive layered red-maroon twin peaks rise on upper right, reflected with fresh green aspens in still water; a few soft pink wildflowers, white daisies and smooth stones along right foreground shore. Pale golden dawn, thin lavender cloud, finely painted reflection, natural mountain proportions, no boats or buildings.

variants.title: Kebler Aspens And Sunlit Ferns
variants.prompt: A different intimate interior of a giant summer aspen grove near Kebler Pass, Colorado: pale white-gray trunks with fine dark knots rise on right, lush large finely divided bracken ferns at their base and vivid fresh rounded green leaves overhead. A low shaft of late afternoon sunlight glows through translucent leaf edges and layers of forest; diagonal fallen branch and mossy stones in foreground. Green summer foliage, absolutely no orange or autumn leaves.

variants.title: Crested Butte Meadow After Rain
variants.prompt: A wide summer wildflower meadow near Crested Butte in Colorado after a passing shower: purple lupines, yellow sunflowers and golden arnica, red paintbrush, and occasional blue columbines on the right; green valley slopes and a rugged mountain silhouette farther back, faint wisps of mist over meadows. Low golden light beneath a dark lavender clearing sky, wet grass and delicate flowers sparkling, no cabins or roads.

Cool luminous evening light with rose glow on far peaks, no cartoon expression, no exaggerated horns or close-up face.

A natural opening in foreground filled with tall vivid pink fireweed spikes and white beargrass, glints of golden morning light on grasses and fine flower petals, thin silver mist in a distant forested valley.
